evidence: SDF-to-Gaussian normal alignment improved normal consistency and voxel IoU but did not materially reduce panel fish-scale patterns or central support diffusion. The residual artifact is therefore more consistent with periodic child-Gaussian placement and post-split footprint spacing.
goal: Reduce periodic fish-scale support patterns by controlling asymmetric split displacement and child scale shrink while keeping the SDF and all geometry regularizers fixed.
fixed: Complete K4 preset, 240 training views, seed 42, 12k, four stages, SDF adaptive-gradient blend 0.50, split threshold 5e-5, no SDF geometry-normal term, no tangent means, no center projection.
parallel_policy: Exactly six variants submitted concurrently with expandable CUDA segments enabled.
robustness_policy: Incomplete K5-test3 and K9-test7 manifests are used only after all six training runs complete.
